propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared discovery kernel instead of combining workflow-authored criteria with unconditional project Round-A fan-in and packaged overlay selection.

Code review must respect effective disables/retunes, activated project DET criteria, project file applicability, and explicit dollar budgets; each selected criterion executes exactly once in Round A with stored reason provenance for disabled/non-applicable criteria.

When a criterion fails, code review must retain successes and continue independent criteria execution, returning BLOCK only for real blocking findings, INDETERMINATE for missing blocking-capable coverage, and PASS for advisory-only missing coverage.
Code review must enforce positive authored usd_budget by shedding over-budget units before calls, reject zero budget via workflow validation, and omit budget constraint when unspecified.
Internal discovery trace must be persisted in code-review journal sidecar versioned format without appearing in review response or status projection.

Code review must preserve authored YAML topology, base-reviewer summary/recommendations, per-overlay context, model-ladder resolution, sequential scheduling, and absence of checkpoints while remaining backward-compatible in public response schema.
